subject: Proposal: Conditional non-PO path for DataBridgeX pilot
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@databridgex.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Request: PO exception for 6-week DataBridgeX pilot

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was excited about the inference routing improvements. We would like to move forward with a 6-week pilot (1 week onboarding + 5 weeks evaluation) starting as early as June 1. Our procurement team is asking for a PO to be raised, but they cannot issue one within the timeline we discussed (lead time is ~3–4 weeks).

Would Redwood consider a temporary carveout to let us run the pilot on invoice with Net30? We will sign the SOW and the MSA; our legal team can accept a short redline to the MSA acknowledging pilot scope and liability limits.

Attachments: DataBridgeX_SOW.pdf (SOW draft), standard-purchase-timing.png (screenshot), MSA (we can sign a redline).

If there are forms or additional evidence needed (insurance certificate, W9, etc.), let me know and I will get them over this week.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Partnerships
DataBridgeX
elena@databridgex.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena@databridgex.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Request: PO exception for 6-week DataBridgeX pilot

Marissa / Priya / Karthik — looping you in on a customer request. DataBridgeX wants to start a short pilot on invoice (no PO available in time). Summary: 6-week pilot, estimated spend ~ $8k–$15k depending on usage, vendor will sign SOW and accept a tailored MSA redline limited to pilot period.

Requests / questions for procurement:
- Can procurement approve a temporary no-PO path for an inbound pilot under $25k with these controls?
- Required artifacts: onboarding form, proof of insurance, W9, signed SOW/MSA redline, billing contact.
- Any finance or vendor-number steps required to invoice without a PO?

Elena — I cc'd our procurement leads. They will confirm required items and any conditions. If approved, I will coordinate the DocuSign and onboarding call.

Internal link: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/procurement/DBX-PR-1287/checklist

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachment: internal-eval-checklist.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: FW: Request: PO exception for 6-week DataBridgeX pilot

Mina — reviewed. Procurement is comfortable granting a conditional exception for this pilot with the following required items and covenants: 

Decision: APPROVE temporary non-PO invoicing for pilot (Procurement request PR-1287) with controls below.

Required artifacts (must be received before first invoice):
- Completed vendor Onboarding Form (fillable PDF) — see attached.
- Signed SOW and MSA redline that limits liability to pilot scope and includes data handling clause.
- Certificate of insurance (minimum limits: GL $1M) and W9 (or country equivalent).
- Billing contact + invoice delivery address; Net30 payment terms.

Operational constraints: 
- Pilot not-to-exceed $25,000 total. If usage approaches this cap we will require a PO or formal contract.
- Finance will create a temporary vendor number and allow monthly invoices against PR-1287.
- Program duration limited to 8 weeks total (onboarding + pilot + 1-week wrap).

Please instruct the customer to submit the onboarding form and the documents above. Once we confirm artifacts, procurement will issue a one-page PO-waiver approval (attached) and notify Finance to accept invoices without a PO for this pilot only.

Attachments: OnboardingForm-fillable.pdf, PO-waiver-approval.pdf

Marissa Cole
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@databridgex.com>, purchasing@databridgex.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T15:06:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: PO exception for 6-week DataBridgeX pilot

Elena — good news: procurement has approved a conditional carveout. Key points from procurement (see Marissa's note below): pilot approved on invoice under PR-1287, not-to-exceed $25k, Net30, onboarding form + insurance + W9 + signed SOW/MSA redline required.

Next steps (action items):
1) Please complete and return the attached OnboardingForm-fillable.pdf.
2) Send certificate of insurance and W9.
3) Sign the attached MSA redline (we've prepared a one-page pilot addendum; DocuSign link below).
4) Billing contact and invoice email.

DocuSign (MSA pilot addendum): https://app.docusign.com/secure/Signing?doc=DBX-MSA-REDLINE-1287
Drive checklist: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/procurement/DBX-PR-1287/checklist

Once we have the docs we'll issue the PO-waiver and Finance will create the temporary vendor number so you can invoice monthly. Can we schedule the onboarding kick-off on Tuesday, June 1 at 10:00 PT? I'll hold the calendar tentative.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
